# Configuration

<!-- Generated by `uv run python -m tools.settings_doc`. Do not edit by hand: CI fails when
this page differs from the settings classes. -->

labhq reads its settings from environment variables. Every variable is optional: an unset
variable keeps the default shown here. Values for lists, sets and mappings are JSON, for
example `LABHQ_MEETINGS_CADENCE_SECONDS='{"standup": 86400}'`.

The one variable labhq passes to the agents it starts is `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, and only when
you set it: it switches Claude Code to API billing (see [Security](security.md#billing)).
labhq has no setting for any other credential of Claude's and never reads one.

A default marked *computed* is worked out on your machine when labhq starts: `LABHQ_DATA_DIR`
is the platform's user data directory for `labhq` (for example `~/.local/share/labhq` on
Linux), and `LABHQ_HEALTH_LOCAL_HOST_NAME` is the machine's host name.

## `labhq.adapters.ollama.OllamaSettings`

Defaults for every Ollama agent, from `LABHQ_OLLAMA_*`; `agents.config` overrides.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | `str` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` |  |
| `LABHQ_OLLAMA_MODEL` | `str` | `llama3.2` |  |
| `LABHQ_OLLAMA_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `5.0` |  |
| `LABHQ_OLLAMA_READ_TIMEOUT_S` | `float` | `300.0` | A cold model loads before its first token arrives; a short read timeout fails that. |

## `labhq.adapters.tmux.TmuxSettings`

The `tmux` adapter: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Aider or any CLI agent (ADR 0003).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_TMUX_SOCKET` | `str` | `labhq` | The private server's socket: `tmux -L labhq attach -t run-<id>` watches a run. |

## `labhq.api.settings.ApiSettings`

API settings, read from `LABHQ_API_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_API_UI_DIR` | `Path` | *computed* | The built desktop UI. Served at `/` only when it exists; the API works without it. |
| `LABHQ_API_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE` | `int` | `50` |  |
| `LABHQ_API_MAX_PAGE_SIZE` | `int` | `200` |  |

## `labhq.budgets.settings.BudgetSettings`

Budget thresholds and period, read from `LABHQ_BUDGET_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_BUDGET_WARN_PERCENT` | `int` | `80` | Whole percentages keep the comparison in integers: spent * 100 >= budget * percent. |
| `LABHQ_BUDGET_STOP_PERCENT` | `int` | `100` |  |
| `LABHQ_BUDGET_PERIOD` | `BudgetPeriod` | `month` |  |

## `labhq.callcenter.calls.settings.CallAgentSettings`

How the Call Center agent row is first created, from `LABHQ_CALLCENTER_*` variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_CALLCENTER_AGENT_ADAPTER` | `str` | `claude` | The SDK adapter until the tmux adapter lands (ADR 0004, Phase 2 amendment). |
| `LABHQ_CALLCENTER_AGENT_MODEL` | `str \| None` | unset |  |
| `LABHQ_CALLCENTER_AGENT_BUDGET_MICROS` | `int` | `2000000` | Its own budget, per budget period, so a chatty call cannot eat the workers' money. |
| `LABHQ_CALLCENTER_AGENT_MAX_TURNS` | `int` | `12` | Reading needs a few tool calls; routing needs one more. |

## `labhq.callcenter.settings.CallCenterSettings`

Call timing, read from `LABHQ_CALLCENTER_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_CALLCENTER_CALL_WINDOW_SECONDS` | `int` | `300` | A call with no activity for this long is treated as hung up. |
| `LABHQ_CALLCENTER_TICKET_EXPIRY_SECONDS` | `int` | `3600` | A request nobody answered within this time becomes `expired` instead of waiting forever. |

|---|---|---|---|

| `LABHQ_DISCORD_GUILD_ID` | `str \| None` | unset |  |
| `LABHQ_DISCORD_OWNER_ID` | `str \| None` | unset | Only this user's messages are read back; everyone else in the server is ignored. |
| `LABHQ_DISCORD_CATEGORY_NAME` | `str` | `labhq` |  |
| `LABHQ_DISCORD_API_BASE` | `str` | `https://discord.com/api/v10` |  |
| `LABHQ_DISCORD_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `int` | `5` |  |
| `LABHQ_DISCORD_RECONNECT_SECONDS` | `float` | `5.0` |  |

## `labhq.health.collectors.registry.CollectionSettings`

Collectors per host kind, as a registry: `kind -> collector`. A new kind is a registration.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_HEALTH_CERTIFICATES` | `dict[str, list[str]]` | `{}` | Host name -> certificates to watch on it, `host:port` or a path, as JSON in the env. |

Health configuration, read from `LABHQ_HEALTH_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_HEALTH_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `float` | `300.0` | Plan §2.2: the collector samples "every few minutes". |
| `LABHQ_HEALTH_LOCAL_HOST_NAME` | `str` | *computed* | Names the `hosts` row the collector creates on first run. |

## `labhq.health.ssh.SshSettings`

Agentless SSH to the hosts labhq watches: a `CommandRunner` over `asyncssh`.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_SSH_KEY_PATH` | `Path \| None` | unset | None uses the owner's SSH agent (and the default identities beside it). |
| `LABHQ_SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_PATH` | `Path \| None` | unset | None keeps the file under the data directory. |
| `LABHQ_SSH_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `15.0` |  |
| `LABHQ_SSH_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `60.0` |  |
| `LABHQ_SSH_INTERVENTION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `float` | `1800.0` | An approved fix (an upgrade, a restart) may run far longer than a probe. |

## `labhq.hierarchy.settings.HierarchySettings`

Hierarchy switches and caps, read from `LABHQ_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_APPROVE_NEW_AGENTS` | `bool` | `true` | Plan §5, rule 4: a new agent waits for a human unless the owner turns this off. |
| `LABHQ_MAX_TEAM_SIZE` | `int` | `8` | Agents under one manager, leads included. Provisional: plan §13 question 4 is open, so this is a setting and a manager's `config["max_team_size"]` overrides it. |
| `LABHQ_ORG_ADAPTER` | `str` | `claude` | The adapter the CEO and the managers it assigns run on, unless the caller names one. |

## `labhq.live.settings.LiveSettings`

Live-update settings, read from `LABHQ_LIVE_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_LIVE_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS` | `float` | `20.0` | Below the 100 s idle timeout of Cloudflare and the 60 s default of nginx and Caddy, so an idle socket is never cut by a proxy; the client treats twice this silence as a dead link. |

## `labhq.meetings.settings.MeetingSettings`

Meeting settings, read from `LABHQ_MEETINGS_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_MEETINGS_CADENCE_SECONDS` | `dict[str, int]` | `{}` | Seconds between two meetings of a kind, per kind. Empty means no meeting is requested on a schedule: the owner has not decided a cadence (plan §13, question 3). |
| `LABHQ_MEETINGS_MINUTES_ATTEMPTS` | `int` | `2` | One retry of the facilitator's minutes, then the meeting fails (issue #73). |
| `LABHQ_MEETINGS_OWNER_NAME` | `str` | `Owner` |  |

## `labhq.memory.settings.MemorySettings`

Who keeps memory and how much, read from `LABHQ_MEMORY_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_MEMORY_ROLES` | `frozenset[str]` | `["ceo", "lead", "manager"]` | Long-lived roles (plan §2). Workers are ephemeral and start every run blank. `agents.config["memory"]` overrides this per agent. |
| `LABHQ_MEMORY_MAX_CHARS` | `int` | `4000` | Memory is read into every prompt, so its size is paid on every run. |

## `labhq.program.settings.ProgramSettings`

How often each background duty of the always-on program runs, from `LABHQ_PROGRAM_*`.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_PROGRAM_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `float` | `5.0` | Matches the scheduler's own tick: a run is never noticed later than it is policed. |
| `LABHQ_PROGRAM_NOTIFY_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `float` | `15.0` | A pending notification waits at most this long; the outbox applies its own backoff. |
| `LABHQ_PROGRAM_STATUS_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `float` | `30.0` | Status files change while a run is live, so a question surfaces before the run ends. |
| `LABHQ_PROGRAM_LIVE_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `float` | `1.0` | How often the change feed reads each live topic's watermark; the UI lags at most this. |
| `LABHQ_PROGRAM_HEALTH_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `float` | `300.0` | Plan §2.2: the collector samples every host "every few minutes". |
| `LABHQ_PROGRAM_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS` | `float` | `10.0` | Time the server gets to stop before it is cancelled on shutdown. |

## `labhq.scheduler.settings.SchedulerSettings`

Scheduler limits, read from `LABHQ_SCHEDULER_*`, and their per-agent overrides.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_SCHEDULER_DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY` | `int` | `1` | Plan §7 rule 2: a low default, one run at a time per agent. |
| `LABHQ_SCHEDULER_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `int` | `3600` |  |
| `LABHQ_SCHEDULER_HEARTBEAT_LIMIT_SECONDS` | `int` | `300` | A run silent for this long has lost its owner. The scheduler beats live runs on every tick, so the limit only has to outlast a few ticks, not a long tool call. |
| `LABHQ_SCHEDULER_INTERRUPT_GRACE_SECONDS` | `int` | `30` | Time a timed-out run gets to honour its interrupt before it is abandoned. |
| `LABHQ_SCHEDULER_TICK_SECONDS` | `float` | `5.0` |  |

## `labhq.settings.Settings`

Process-wide configuration, read from `LABHQ_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_DATA_DIR` | `Path` | *computed* |  |
| `LABHQ_DATABASE_URL` | `str \| None` | unset | Overrides the SQLite file under `data_dir`; tests and CI point it at a scratch database. |
| `LABHQ_CLI_PATH` | `Path \| None` | unset | The SDK wheel bundles its own Claude Code build; runs pin the installed one instead (spikes/agent_sdk/RESULTS.md). |

## `labhq.speech.settings.SpeechSettings`

Speech limits, read from `LABHQ_SPEECH_*` environment variables.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_SPEECH_MAX_SENTENCE_WORDS` | `int` | `40` | A sentence longer than this cannot be followed by ear. |

## `labhq.usage.settings.UsageSettings`

Plan usage thresholds and extraction settings, read from `LABHQ_*` (ADR 0003).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LABHQ_PLAN_USAGE_WARN_PERCENT` | `int` | `50` | labhq warns at this share of a plan window and starts no new run from the stop share, leaving the rest of every window to the owner (owner decision, 2026-10-03). |
| `LABHQ_PLAN_USAGE_STOP_PERCENT` | `int` | `70` |  |
| `LABHQ_PLAN_LIMIT_HOLD_SECONDS` | `int` | `3600` | A limit notice that names no reset time holds new runs for this long. |
| `LABHQ_USAGE_EXTRACTOR` | `str` | `model` | The extractor registry key, and the agent whose one-shot runs do the model extraction. |
| `LABHQ_USAGE_EXTRACTOR_AGENT_ID` | `int \| None` | unset |  |
| `LABHQ_USAGE_MAX_RESET_DAYS` | `int` | `8` | A reset time further away than this is not a plan window; the reading is rejected. |
